content: MapLibre GL JS is the MIT-licensed, free fork of Mapbox GL JS v1 with no API key/usage billing; Mapbox GL JS v2+ is proprietary, requires an account token, free tier 50K web map loads/mo then ~/1K loads. For a budget solo project, MapLibre + a free/cheap tile provider (e.g. MapTiler free tier, OpenFreeMap, or self-hosted OSM tiles) avoids per-load billing risk entirely.
